mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.authrt_cd, u.user_email, u.user_phn_num, u.user_birth, u.user_gender, u.user_addr, u.join_ymd, u.user_nm, u.user_pst_ablty, u.user_pst, u.user_level, u.user_intro, f.file_path, t.team_cd, t.team_nm, t.rgn_nm, t.gender, ta.team_age_name AS ageGroup, t.act_dow, l.tier AS level FROM user u LEFT JOIN files f ON u.user_img = f.file_idx LEFT JOIN team_user tu ON u.user_id = tu.user_cd LEFT JOIN team t ON tu.team_cd = t.team_cd LEFT JOIN team_age ta ON t.team_age = ta.team_age_cd LEFT JOIN levels l ON t.level_cd = l.level_cd WHERE u.user_email = #{email}
mapper.update:
UPDATE user
user_nm = #{name},
user_intro = #{intro},
user_pst = #{pst},
user_pst_ablty = #{pstAblty},
user_addr = #{addr},
user_img = #{profile},
WHERE user_email = #{email}
mapper.select: SELECT t.team_cd AS teamCd, t.team_nm AS teamNm, t.rgn_nm AS rgnNm, t.gender AS gender, ta.team_age_name AS ageGroup, t.act_dow AS actDow, l.tier AS level, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_user tu2 WHERE tu2.team_cd = t.team_cd ) AS memberCount FROM team t JOIN team_user tu ON t.team_cd = tu.team_cd JOIN user u ON tu.user_cd = u.user_id LEFT JOIN team_age ta ON t.team_age = ta.team_age_cd LEFT JOIN levels l ON t.level_cd = l.level_cd WHERE u.user_email = #{email}
